title: Jewels and Stones
summary: Determine the count of stones that are also jewels by comparing the characters in the stones string against the jewels string, considering case sensitivity.
statement: Determine the count of stones that are also jewels by comparing the characters in the stones string against the jewels string, considering case sensitivity.
constraints: Jewel characters are distinct and matching is case-sensitive.
Count how many stone characters belong to the jewel set.
hints: Membership is repeated many times against a fixed set of jewel characters.
Build a set of jewel kinds and count matching stones.
kinds=set(jewels); sum(stone in kinds for stone in stones).
Set membership preserves case and counts each stone occurrence independently in linear expected time.
